title: Volley Coordinator Role
description: The retained state of the coordinator role: the owner's Claude Code Remote Control server, which the supervisor keeps alive in a fixed directory on the machine coordinator.machine names. Published by the supervisor to volley/_system/federation/coordinator at start and on every change, and cleared (an empty retained payload) while coordinator.machine is null. Accepted only from agent_id volleyd. See spec section 4.6.25.

machine.description: The machine it runs on: local (the supervisor's own) or a paired machine's name.

name.description: The coordinator name the server runs under (--name), the one waves bind to: the phone's session list shows it.

state.description: starting: launched, its link not read yet. running: its session is up. restarting: it died and starts again after its backoff. stopped: not running (the owner stopped it, its machine is down, or it could not be started: last_error says which). failed: it died (or could not be started) three times in a row soon after starting; it stays down until coordinator_restart.

session_url.description: The link the server printed on its screen; absent until read, or when it printed none (the name is the handle then).

restarts.description: Restarts after a death since it last started fresh (a coordinator_restart counts from 0).

last_error.description: Why it is stopped, restarting or failed (the server's last screen lines after a death), or the question it waits on.

needs_terminal.description: The server asks on its screen and nobody answers unattended: trust (Claude Code's folder trust for the directory) or consent (the first run's Enable Remote Control?). Someone attaches to its tmux session and answers.

dir.description: Its directory on that machine, absolute (coordinator.dir expanded there); absent until the supervisor has expanded it, as while its machine is down before the role was first placed there.
